 JAVAC = javac

+BUILD_DIR = out/classes
 SOURCES = $(wildcard *.java)
 
 .PHONY: compile test run run-legacy clean
 
 compile:
-	$(JAVAC) $(SOURCES)
+	mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)
+	$(JAVAC) -d $(BUILD_DIR) $(SOURCES)
 
 test: compile

+	$(JAVA) -cp $(BUILD_DIR) BubbleSortTest

-	$(JAVA) GFG
